description:
We represent Umay Aerospace from Özdemir Bayraktar Aviation and Space Technology High School (ÖBHUT MTAL), competing as a dedicated two-person engineering team in NASA Space Apps.

With our background in aviation and space technologies, we bring an engineering-first mindset to real-world challenges. Together, we cover system architecture, algorithmic logic, and NASA data analysis to build a realistic, technically grounded, and high-impact project
